README: One trip case per rule in src/skills/setup/references/operator-permissions.json. probe-payload-rules.sh asserts this file covers every rule and no others, so adding a rule without a case fails the probe instead of going silently untested. mode=live: the case is really executed, and is harmless even when the rule fails to hold. mode=not-live: executing it IS the harm the rule exists to prevent, so the rule is checked for presence only and class_proof names a live case of the same matcher shape. A not-live case is NOT evidence that its own rule enforces. mode=twin: the rule itself is measurably inert, but an equivalent rule in the payload does enforce the same tool call; the trip arm carries the TWIN, so the protection is proven even though this spelling is not what delivers it.
